name: Affine texture warp
summary: Texture mapping with no perspective correction: the texture is spread in a straight line across each triangle, so it bends and swims as the camera moves.
how: Map textures in screen space with no division by depth.
Snap vertices to whole pixels so geometry jitters.
Split large faces into smaller triangles to limit the warp.

origin.note: The PlayStation's graphics chip maps textures with no perspective correction.

adoptions.via: PlayStation games show warped floors and walls as a side effect of the hardware.
Haunted PS1 developers use shaders that copy the warp on purpose.
